paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Pharoah kiang ah va lut inla, TOUPA Hebrute' Pathian in ka nna aseptheihna ding un ka mite paisak in.
heading: Gantate Sihna

paite: Amaute paisak na nial a, amau na letdet laileh,
ngai in, TOUPA khut, lou a om na bawnghonte tung ah, sakolte tung ah, sabiltungte tung ah, sangawngsaute tung ah, bawngtalte tung ah leh belamte tung ah atu ding. Hipi nase mahmah a-om ding hi.
TOUPA'N Israelte bawnghon leh Aiguptate bawnghon asatkhen ding. Israel suante a lam bangmah si a-om kei ding.
TOUPA'N hun biseh asepta, zingchiang in TOUPA'N gamsung ah hiai ahih ding,” chi in va gen in.
Huan azing in TOUPA'N hiai thil ahih a, Aigupta bawnghon tengteng asita uhi. Himahleh Israel suante bawnghonte khat lel leng asi kei hi.
Pharaoh in mi asawl a, ngai in, Israel bawnghonte lak ah khat lel leng asi kei ngut hi. Himahleh Pharaoh lungtang akhauh a, mite apaisak kei lai hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi leh Aaron kiang ah, "Meiphualpi vut na khut dim un la unla, Pharaoh muh in Mosi in van lam ah theh hen.
heading: Meimatum

paite: Aigupta gam ah leivui nen ahong suak dia, Aigupta gamsung teng ah, mi tung leh sa tung ah meimatum nasetak ahong hi ding," achi hi.
Meiphualpi a vut ala ua, Pharaoh mai ah adinghta uhi. Mosi in van lam ah athehtou a; mi tung leh sa tung ah, meimatum ahong suakta hi.
Huchi in meimatumte ziak in Mosi ma ah mitkhialdawi tawite adingh theita kei ua; mitkhialdawi tawite tung leh Aiguptate tung ah lah meimatum a-om ngal a.
Himahleh TOUPA'N Pharaoh lungtang akhauhsak a, Mosi kiang a TOUPA'N agen bang in amau thu angaikhe kei hi.
Huan TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Zingkhang in thou inla, Pharaoh ma ah va dingh inla, akiang ah, TOUPA Hebrute' Pathian in hichi in achi, 'Ka nna aseptheihna ding un ka mite paisak in.
heading: Gial

paite: Hiai hun in na lungtang tung leh na sikhate tung leh na mite tung a ka gawtna tengteng hon tun ding ka hi ngal a. Lei pumpi ah kei bang kuamah a-om kei, chih na theihna ding in.
Tu in ka khut zankhia in nang leh na mite hipi in hon gawt leng lei a pan satkhiak in na om ding hi.
Himahleh hiai ziak in ahi, nang ka hon tunding, nangmah a ka thilhihtheihna ka latsak theihna ding leh huchi a leitung tengteng a ka min akipuankhiak theihna ding in.
Amaute paisaklou ding in, ka mite kalh in nang leh nang na kiliansak nalai maw?
Ngai in, zingchiang tu hun in apian tung a kipan tutan a om ngei nai lou, Aigupta gam ah gialpi tam petmah ka zusak ding hi.

Huaiziak in tu in mi sawl inla, lou a na neih tengteng leh na gantate kaikhawm in. Michih tung leh lou a kimu sa tung ah, inn lam a hong kihawlloute tung ah, gial ahong kesuk ding a, asi ding uh,' achi," chi in.
Kuapeuh Pharaoh sikhate lak a TOUPA thu laute'n asikhate leh agantate uh insung ah ahawllut uhi.
TOUPA thu khawksaloute'n lou ah asikhate uh leh agantate uh anusia uhi.
Huchi in TOUPA'N Mosi kiang ah, "Aigupta gam tengteng a, mi leh sa tung leh Aigupta gam tengteng alou a haichi tung teng a gial a-omtheihna ding in, van lam ah na khut zankhia in,” achi hi.
Mosi in van lam ah achiangkhun azankhia hi. TOUPA'N van-ging leh gial ahon sawl a, leitung zui in meikuang ataita a; TOUPA'N Aigupta gam tung ah gial azusakta hi.
Huchi in gial a-om a, gial toh kihel meikuang huaise mahmah, nam ahih nungsiah Aigupta gam ah huchibang om ngei kei hi.
Gial in Aigupta gamsungte a lou omte teng adengta hi. Gial in mi leh sa; lou a haichi chih adeng a, gam a sing chih akitansakta hi.
Israel suante tenna, Goshen gam kia ah gial ake kei hi.
Pharaoh in mi asawl a, Mosi leh Aaron asamsak a, akiang uah, "Tutung in ka khialta. TOUPA adiktat a, kei leh ka mite ka gilou uh.
TOUPA ngen in, ahunta, vanpiging leh gial thupi a-om nawnlouhna ding in. K'on paisakta dia, na om nawn kei ding uh," achi hi.

Huan Mosi in akiang ah, "Khopi a pan ka pawtkhiak chiang in TOUPA lam ah ka khutte ka zak ding a; vanpiging adai dia, gial leng a-om nawn kei ding; huchi a leitung TOUPA a ahihdan na theihtheihna ding in.
Himahleh nang leh na sikhate'n ahihleh, TOUPA Pathian na lau nai kei ding uh chih ka thei," achi hi.
Pat leh barli buh densiat in a-om a, barli buh atuipumta a, pat gah akuhmumta hi.
Himahleh huit buh leh buhman zaw densiat in a-om kei; anou lai ziak un.
Pharaoh a pan Mosi in khopi apawtkhiaksan in, TOUPA lam ah akhutte azak a; vanpiging leh gial adai a, leitung ah vuah buak in a-omta kei hi.
Pharaoh in vuah leh gial leh vanpiging atawpta chih atheih in, akhial tamsem a, amah leh asikhate'n alungtang uh akhauhsak uhi.
Huchi in Pharaoh lungtang khauhsak in a-om a, Mosi kam a TOUPA'N agen bang in Israel suante apaisak nuam kei hi.
